paragraphs.text: The retry boundary sits around each invoice submission, not around the entire nightly batch. A timeout therefore resubmits only the affected invoice. The external service uses the invoice identifier as an idempotency key, so a delayed response cannot cause the retry to create a second charge for the same invoice.
